غَيَدٌ [mentioned above as an inf. n.], in a woman, (S, K,) or in a young woman, (L,) Softness, or tenderness, (S, L, K,) and limberness (L, K) of the sides. (L.) ―
-b2- And Drowiness: (A:) [or drowsiness with a bending of the neck: see أَغْيَدُ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
